# conative_azuresql_database_user (Data Source)

Reads one database user by name. The data source fails if the user does not exist; use `conative_azuresql_database_users` to check for existence without failing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "conative_azuresql_database_user" "app" {
  database = "orders"
  name     = "orders-app"
}

output "app_sid" {
  value = data.conative_azuresql_database_user.app.sid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database name.
- `name` (String) User name.

### Read-Only

- `entra_id` (String) The Entra ID the security identifier was derived from. Null when it cannot be derived, for example for a user that is not an external user.
- `id` (String) The import ID of the user, `database/name`.
- `principal_type` (String) The principal type as reported by the database, for example `EXTERNAL_USER`, `EXTERNAL_GROUP` or `SQL_USER`.
- `sid` (String) The user's security identifier as reported by the database, as `0x` followed by hexadecimal digits.
